# OpenGait Source

The OpenGait repository is not vendored in this project. Fetch the pinned
official source with:

```bash
bash lidargaitpp/scripts/fetch_opengait.sh
```

The command checks out commit
`f754f6f3831e9f83bb28f4e2f63dd43d8bcf9dc4`, applies the included runtime
compatibility patch, and verifies the official LidarGait++ source hashes.
OpenGait remains subject to its upstream license.
